Name: Super Multipliers
Author: smallerpoorer
Description:
1. 🌟 经验倍率 (0.1 - 20 倍)[list]
[*][b]耕种经验[/b] 
[*][b]采矿经验[/b] 
[*][b]采集经验[/b] 
[*][b]钓鱼经验[/b] 
[*][b]战斗经验[/b] 
[/list]2. 💎 掉落与物品 (0.1 - 20 倍)[list]
[*][b]全局掉落倍率[/b]：需要把物品丢在地上然后再捡起来。
[*][b]物品售价倍率[/b]：所有物品的出货价格倍率。
[/list]3. ⚙️ 机器与资源[list]
[*][b]机器加工速度[/b] (最高 20 倍)：大幅缩短酿酒桶、熔炉、宝石复制机等机器的等待时间。
[*][b]围栏耐久倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：减缓或停止围栏腐烂。
[*][b]树木生长概率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：加速树木自然生长。
[/list]4. 🪓 一击破坏 (开关)[list]
[*][b]一击砍树[/b]：斧头一击砍倒普通树木。
[*][b]一击碎硬物[/b]：秒碎大树桩、大圆木、陨石、大石头。
[*][b]一击挖矿[/b]：秒碎普通矿石、水晶、石头。
[/list]5. 🏃 玩家属性[list]
[*][b]锁血[/b]
[*][b]防御倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：减少受到的伤害。
[*][b]无限水壶[/b] (开关)：水壶永不干涸。
[*][b]移动速度加成[/b] (0 - 10 点)：增加玩家的基础行走速度。
[*][b]磁力倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：包含[b]强力吸附[/b]功能，物品会光速飞向玩家。
[/list]6. ⚔️ 战斗[list]
[*][b]武器伤害倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：直接增加最终伤害数值。
[/list]7. 🎣 钓鱼辅助[list]
[*][b]瞬间钓起[/b] (开关)：鱼咬钩后直接捕获，跳过小游戏。
[*][b]绿条大小倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：增加钓鱼条的长度。
[*][b]宝箱概率倍率[/b] (0.1 - 20 倍)：增加钓鱼出现宝箱的几率。
[/list][list]
[*]⚠️ 注意：请勿与 AutoFish 同时开启，不会崩溃，会报错。
[/list]8. ❤️ 社交与世界 (0.1 - 20 倍)[list]
[*][b]友谊倍率[/b]：增加送礼或对话获得的友谊值。
[*][b]矿井梯子出现概率[/b]：增加敲石头出现梯子的几率。
[*][b]每日运气倍率[/b]：修改电视里的每日运气值。
[/list]
生长加工速度的提升是[b]游戏时间[/b] 正常流逝了 [b]10分钟，可以通过mod变成60分钟[/b][line]🇺🇸 English Version (英文版)1. 🌟 Experience Multipliers (0.1x - 20x)[list]
[*][b]Farming XP[/b]
[*][b]Mining XP[/b]
[*][b]Foraging XP[/b]
[*][b]Fishing XP[/b]
[*][b]Combat XP[/b]
[/list]2. 💎 Drops & Items (0.1x - 20x)[list]
[*][b]Global Drop Multiplier[/b]: Applies to [b]everything[/b] -Drop the item and pick it back up
[*][b]Sell Price Multiplier[/b]: Increases the shipping price of all items.
[/list]3. ⚙️ Machines & Resources[list]
[*][b]Machine Processing Speed[/b] (Max 100x): Drastically reduces processing time for Kegs, Furnaces, Crystalariums, etc.
[*][b]Fence Decay Multiplier[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Slows down or stops fence decay.
[*][b]Tree Growth Chance[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Accelerates natural tree growth.
[/list]4. 🪓 One-Hit Break (Toggle On/Off)[list]
[*][b]One-Hit Trees[/b]: Chop down standard trees instantly.
[*][b]One-Hit Resource Clumps[/b]: Instantly break Stumps, Logs, Meteorites, and Boulders.
[*][b]One-Hit Mining[/b]: Instantly break Ores, Crystals, and Stones.
[/list]5. 🏃 Player Stats[list]
[*][b][/b]Lock Health
[*][b]Defense Multiplier[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Reduces damage taken.
[*][b]Infinite Watering Can[/b] (Toggle): Never run out of water.
[*][b]Movement Speed Addon[/b] (+0 to +10): Adds base movement speed.
[*][b]Magnet Radius Multiplier[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Includes [b]Super Vacuum[/b] feature (items fly to you instantly).
[/list]6. ⚔️ Combat[list]
[*][b]Weapon Damage Multiplier[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Directly multiplies final damage dealt.
[/list]7. 🎣 Fishing Assists[list]
[*][b]Instant Catch[/b] (Toggle): Catch fish immediately upon hooking (skips minigame).
[*][b]Fishing Bar Size[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Multiplies the size of the green bar.
[*][b]Treasure Chance[/b] (0.1x - 20x): Increases the chance of finding treasure chests.
[/list][list]
[*]⚠️ Note: Do not use with [code]AutoFish[/code]
. It won't crash the game, but it will throw console errors.[/list]8. ❤️ Social & World (0.1x - 20x)[list]
[*][b]Friendship Multiplier[/b]: Increases friendship points gained from gifts/talking.
[*][b]Ladder Chance[/b]: Increases the chance of finding ladders in the mines.
[*][b]Daily Luck Multiplier[/b]: Multiplies the daily luck value.
[/list]
"The boost to growth and processing speed means that when 10 minutes of in-game time pass normally, the mod makes it count as 60 minutes."
